name: Costume runway
summary: Halloween costume stories walk a drawn runway one by one as illustrated characters; viewers heart the looks they love, and the final walk lines everyone up, crowns the most-hearted costume and hands out the group's categories.

where.description: Small line under the title, e.g. '412 Pine · Oct 31'

by.description: Who wore it, by first name

costume.description: What they called it, lowercase, e.g. 'cardboard robot'
